episode_summary: In this episode, Danny Brown shares insights on building a reputation in luxury real estate, emphasizing the importance of integrity and long-term relationships. He discusses strategies for moving up market and managing ultra high net worth clients, providing valuable advice for agents looking to elevate their business. Danny also reflects on his career path and the lessons learned from his mentors.
